messages.content: Help me update the data in a spreadsheet view within a database application, ensuring that metadata is refreshed, existing data is appended, and the current state is preserved?

function.name: SpreadsheetPresentation_refreshData
function.description: Refreshes the data in the spreadsheet view, with options to refresh metadata, append data, and keep the current state. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

refreshMetadata.description: Indicates whether to refresh the metadata. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

append.description: Indicates whether to append the data to the existing data. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

keepState.description: Indicates whether to preserve the current state of the spreadsheet. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to update data in a spreadsheet view within a database application, ensuring that metadata is refreshed, existing data is appended, and the current state is preserved. The developer has provided a tool called functions.SpreadsheetPresentation_refreshData which takes parameters: refreshMetadata (string representing Java boolean), append (string representing Java boolean), keepState (string representing Java boolean). We need to call this function with appropriate arguments.

We should interpret "metadata is refreshed" as refreshMetadata=true. "existing data is appended" means append=true. "current state is preserved" means keepState=true. So we call the function with those values. The function returns any; we can just return the result or maybe we need to handle it. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we will call the function with refreshMetadata="true", append="true", keepState="true". Then we output the result.
